title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - ControllingFunction
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/ControllingFunction. A function that allows a device to control another device (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.4), e.g. the audio-control wearable of TS 103 410-9 Figure 10 that controls a facility's speakers. Subclass of saref:Function. controlsDevice is added for a usable candidate model, grounded in the ontology's own example (saref:controls).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ControllingFunction'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

controlsDevice.description: Relationship. Device(s) controlled by this function. Links to one or more device entities (URIs).
